title: Wargaming 联合创始人创办的 Mika Games 融资1000万美元，投资软发布之后的团队
content:
Wargaming cofounder’s Mika Games raises $10m to back studios beyond soft launch – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Mika Games, the investment company founded by Wargaming cofounder Nick Katselapov, has raised a further $10m in a new funding round.
Mika announced the round, led by Flint Capital today, October 21, saying it will help mobile studios address the “catch-22” of needing “a proven marketing track record to access financing, but need upfront capital to build it”.
Mika also pointed to
stats
claiming US top 1,000 by downloads nearly halved between 2020 and 2024.
The investment outfit combines equity funding for teams and product development with separate capital for paid user acquisition tests. It says successful tests can help studios qualify for further financing.
Its portfolio includes five studios, among them Legendale, which has more than 3m players, and Punko, which has more than 500,000 downloads.
Mika
invested
$2m in Punko developer Agonalea Games in 2025 and has said it aims to deploy $50m in total.
